name: Dual regime gate (risk-on macro + calm VIX) arms RSI-oversold reversion (large-cap majors)
rationale: THESIS: RSI-oversold dip-buying works only when the macro window is open and equity vol is calm; the oversold reading is momentum-relative, the gate is the orthogonal arming switch. DUAL GATE: macro_regime above a fitted risk-on level AND vix_level below a non-extreme ceiling. RSI < floor is the trigger. This is the RSI sibling of the bb_z washout family (a different oversold definition: momentum-relative vs band-relative), run on the most macro-coupled large caps (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, BNBUSDT). DISCONFIRMER 1 (just buy-the-dip?): the bare RSI-oversold entry with NO dual gate (fear-greed/feargreed family already has ungated dip controls) must be the baseline; gated deflated Sharpe must clear it net of the extra exits. DISCONFIRMER 2 (is RSI or bb_z carrying the signal?): the spec-1 bb_z sibling under the same gate is the cross-check; if RSI-gated is no better than bb_z-gated they are the same trade and only one survives parsimony. DISCONFIRMER 3 (vix the active ingredient?): a sibling that removes ONLY the vix gate isolates whether macro alone suffices. DISCONFIRMER 4 (holdout): recent purged slice stays positive.
catalyst: RSI prints oversold while macro_regime is risk-on and vix_level is calm
